mapper.select: SELECT bank_code,bank_name,bank_type,icon_url FROM ref_bank WHERE status=#{status} ORDER BY bank_code
SELECT MAX(synced_at) FROM ref_bank WHERE status=#{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ref_bank WHERE status=#{status} AND bank_code=#{bankCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE ref_bank SET status='INACTIVE' WHERE status=#{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ref_bank (bank_code,bank_name,bank_type,icon_url,status,synced_at) VALUES (#{bankCode},#{bankName},#{bankType},#{iconUrl},#{status},#{syncedAt,typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bank_name=VALUES(bank_name),bank_type=VALUES(bank_type),icon_url=VALUES(icon_url),status=VALUES(status),synced_at=VALUES(synced_at)
